design_rules.name: Local High-Frequency Decoupling
design_rules.description: Every IC VCC pin must have a 100nF ceramic capacitor within 3mm to 5mm of the pin with direct via to ground plane.

design_rules.name: Switching Loop Area Minimization
design_rules.description: The high di/dt loop in buck/boost converters (SW pin -> Inductor -> Output Cap -> Diode/GND) must have minimal loop area to prevent radiated EMI.

design_rules.name: Crystal Oscillator Trace Routing
design_rules.description: Keep crystal and load capacitor traces as short as possible; provide dedicated guard ring/ground island beneath crystal.
